Class PdfExportService

java.lang.Object
moldsim.controller.PdfExportService
public class PdfExportService extends Object
Service responsible for generating and opening PDF simulation reports.

This class collects simulation statistics, alert history, and environment data, then delegates report generation to the PDF exporter.
